But man…{{wi}} I’m glad that Melissa became a part of our group.
She did a terrible thing, but what alternative did she have? 
I was thinking about it a lot, and I did not come up with a solution to her situation.
She couldn’t ask anyone for help, even the police, since if she did, that bastard would reveal her secret. 
I don’t know if this is what is called a self-defense situation, but it’s got to be at least pretty close.
The death of that woman, though…{{wi}} Melissa isn’t very expressive, but I can tell that it weighs heavy on her.
I wish I could turn back time and reach out to her sooner so that all of this could be avoided, but that’s just wishful thinking. 
I need to focus on reality and help Melissa cope with what she’s done.
Unfortunately I have no idea how to do it. 
They say that time heals wounds. I hope that’s true even for bots.
